title: Pan the map opened from a photo's sidebar
steps: Inspect the open landscape photo and the Location Information mini-map in its sidebar.
Click the Location Information mini-map to open the photo on the full map.
Swipe the full map to the left.

video_guide.summary: Watch the landscape card and its blue marker move together during the pan and remain aligned afterward.

chapters.label: Review the selected photo on the map

chapters.note: The landscape details card is open above its blue location marker.
The landscape card is positioned above its blue photo marker in the panned map view.
The open landscape card remains positioned above the same blue marker.
